chronology.no_refractory_rule: not needed; hourly grid gives deterministic non-overlapping spacing

novelty_boundary.h03_tested_object: impulse extremeness (tail-percentile trigger, continuation vs exhaustion)
novelty_boundary.b2_03_tested_object: path morphology conditional on displacement, not displacement magnitude itself

displacement.direction: d = sign(D_W(T)); UP if d=+1, DOWN if d=-1
displacement.path_return_definition: r_i = ln(close_i/close_{i-1}), i=1..N; sum_i r_i == D_W(T) by telescoping
displacement.availability_rule: every 5m bucket entering r_1..r_N and the anchor close_0 must have available_at<=T; no still-forming bar

eligibility: T is an hourly UTC boundary, T>=warmup_start, T strictly before development_end_exclusive
every source bar/bucket the record needs (W-window 5m returns, 60m PRE_VOL window) is fully available with available_at<=T
event_construction.unavailable_morphology_policy: record remains a constructed event; scoring-only field becomes UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DECISION for both candidate and baseline; never deleted from population; never changes another event's causal reference/training population
event_construction.warmup_records: constructible as causal reference/training material only; never scored

baseline_context.displacement_mag_reference_population: eligible hourly B2-03 decision records same W, preceding 30 calendar days strictly before current T, current event excluded, UP/DOWN pooled (unsigned magnitude)

vol_boundary.interpretation: exactly 60 consecutive complete canonical 1m bars; no 59-return or 61-return interpretation; fewer or more than exactly 60 returns fails the record closed

baseline_context.vol_reference_population: preceding 30 calendar days, hourly B2-03 decision grid, strictly before T, current event excluded
baseline_context.empty_reference: UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DECISION for both candidate and baseline; no fallback

formulas.PRE_VOL_60: sqrt(sum_{i=1..60} r_i^2); r_i=ln(close_i/close_{i-1}); close_0=close(T-60m); close_1..close_60 are the 60 consecutive complete 1m bar closes covering [T-60m,T); available_at<=T for close_0 and all 60 bars

morphology_descriptor.component_transform: causal_midrank_percentile within same W using prior eligible B2-03 records, UP/DOWN pooled since components are direction-normalized
morphology_descriptor.reference_population: prior eligible B2-03 records, same W, reference_T strictly before current T, current event excluded, feature fully available by its own event T
morphology_descriptor.empty_reference: UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DECISION for both candidate and baseline; no fallback
morphology_descriptor.undefined_policy: TV<=0 or any undefined/non-finite component makes both candidate and baseline UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DECISION

formulas.PATH_EFFICIENCY: abs(D_W(T))/TV; bounded [0,1] by triangle inequality abs(sum r_i)<=sum abs(r_i)
formulas.DIRECTIONAL_BAR_SHARE: count_i(d*r_i>0)/N; zero return does not count
formulas.COUNTERMOVE_SHALLOWNESS: 1 - MAX_COUNTERMOVE/TV; z_0=0, z_j=d*sum_{i=1..j}r_i, peak_j=max(z_0..z_j), MAX_COUNTERMOVE=max_j(peak_j-z_j); require 0<=MAX_COUNTERMOVE/TV<=1 as an enforced construction invariant

morphology_descriptor.not_a_rebinning_of_magnitude: TV and abs(D_W(T)) are distinct quantities related only by the triangle inequality; conditioning both models on DISPLACEMENT_MAG_STATE additionally removes residual scale before morphology percentiles are computed
morphology_descriptor.expected_ordering: HIGH morphology > LOW morphology on the direction-normalized continuation residual

target.scale_reference: median absolute H-horizon close return at prior canonical UTC 15-minute grid decision points over the preceding 30 calendar days, using only reference points whose own H-horizon outcome is fully known by current T (ref_t+H<=T)
target.scale_denominator_requirements: finite, positive, known by T; no winsorization, no future-informed floor, no sign flip

forecast.joint_unavailability: if either candidate or baseline cannot produce a valid prediction, the scored record is unavailable for both

controls.permutation_scope: per-scored-event causal 90d training set with training_T+H<=current_T
controls.permutation_target: historical MORPHOLOGY_STATE labels only; historical Y fixed; evaluation event's own morphology state fixed
controls.permutation_ordering: sort each stratum by canonical event ID (event_identity.canonical_serialization) before RNG, then permute

seed_derivation_primitive.description: pipe-join str(part) for each ordered part in the seed_derivation sequence, UTF-8 encode, SHA-256, take the first 16 hex digits as an integer

baseline_stratum_id_serialization.w_representation: plain base-10 integer, no leading zero
baseline_stratum_id_serialization.direction_representation: exactly UP or DOWN, uppercase ASCII
baseline_stratum_id_serialization.state_representation: exactly LOW, MID, or HIGH, uppercase ASCII

controls.current_T_representation: T_ms: integer UTC epoch milliseconds, identical representation to event_identity.canonical_serialization.timestamp_representation

bootstrap_positive.pooled_condition: 95% UTC-week block-bootstrap lower bound for mean AE improvement > 0

placebo_separation.placebo_q95_definition: 95th percentile of the frozen 100 causal permutation replicates (controls.permutation_replicates)

morphology_ordering.definition: BASE_RESIDUAL = Y_H - BASE_PRED; MORPHOLOGY_SEPARATION(subset) = median(BASE_RESIDUAL | MORPHOLOGY_STATE=HIGH, subset) - median(BASE_RESIDUAL | MORPHOLOGY_STATE=LOW, subset)

anti_rescue_side_symmetry.rationale: pooling UP+DOWN into one (W,H) cell does not by itself block a one-sided effect from dominating a null/negative effect on the other side while the pooled metric remains positive

promotion_gate_contract.horizon_robustness: for one W, at least two adjacent horizons in [15,30,60,120,240] (adjacent pairs 15/30, 30/60, 60/120, 120/240) pass all five per-cell gates, including the anti_rescue_side_symmetry subconditions
promotion_gate_contract.parameter_robustness: the exact same adjacent-H pair also passes all five per-cell gates for at least one other W; no single W may promote alone
promotion_gate_contract.year_stability: every promotion-neighborhood cell has positive pooled mean AE improvement in >=4/5 development years (2020,2021,2022,2023,2024); no year exclusions
promotion_gate_contract.direction_pooling: DIRECTION is a shared baseline+candidate stratum dimension pooled into each (W,H) cell; pooling alone does not block a one-sided rescue of primary_positive/morphology_ordering, so those two gates additionally require finite UP and DOWN subconditions (see anti_rescue_side_symmetry); a formulation whose pooled cell fails cannot be rescued by a single direction either way

reporting_contract.component_distributions: descriptive only; never a promotion gate beyond the mandatory subconditions in promotion_gate_contract.anti_rescue_side_symmetry

canonical_serialization.integer_representation: plain base-10, no leading zero, no unit suffix
canonical_serialization.direction_representation: exactly UP or DOWN, uppercase ASCII
